versions.subject: Merge PR #5471 from @swachchhanda000 - feat: BadSuccessor Exploits Detection
versions.detection:
selection:
    - Image|endswith: '\SharpSuccessor.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'SharpSuccessor.exe'
    - CommandLine|contains: 'SharpSuccessor'
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
          - ' add '
          - ' /impersonate'
          - ' /path'
          - ' /account'
          - ' /name'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\SharpSuccessor.exe" OR OriginalFileName="SharpSuccessor.exe" OR CommandLine="*SharpSuccessor*" OR (CommandLine="* add *" CommandLine="* /impersonate*" CommandLine="* /path*" CommandLine="* /account*" CommandLine="* /name*")
